run_python.description: Run a short Python or JavaScript script for the things no other step covers, such as reshaping data or a custom calculation. It runs offline, with no internet or file access, and returns whatever your script assigns to a variable named output.
run_python.name: run_python

parameters.description: Python or JavaScript. Both run offline in the same sandbox, read the same inputs, and return what the code assigns to output. JavaScript is the language only: there is no Node, require or npm, and an error inside async code (an async function or .then) isn't reported.
parameters.name: language

parameters.description: Your script. Read the values you mapped in by name, or from inputs, and assign this step's result to a variable named output.
parameters.name: code

parameters.description: The workflow values your code can use. Each one gets a name you refer to in the code.
parameters.name: inputs

parameters.description: What this step returns. Auto keeps whatever your code produced; picking a type checks it before later steps use it.
parameters.name: output_type

returns.description: Whatever the script assigns to output, converted to the chosen output type.

description: Run a small Python or JavaScript script in a secure sandbox.
